card.name: Beliefs, principles and dissatisfaction with something
card.fires_on: Words about convictions or principles, such as principles, integrity, belief, renounced, pacifist, and the word with right after dissatisfaction. Mostly in general web prose about people's values or attitudes.

modes.label: Dissatisfaction with
modes.description: The word with (or dissatisfaction) in the phrase expressing discontent toward something.
modes.example: eventually left the profession due to dissatisfaction<< with>> the minute amount of time the job left

modes.label: Values and principles words
modes.description: Words naming or partway through convictions, such as principles, belief, integrity, pacifist, renounced.
modes.example: to embrace and promote the<< principles>> of fair trade.

card.plain: It lights up on words about personal beliefs and values, and on the phrase dissatisfaction with.
